rules.heading: 0. Never work around a control
rules.quote: ENFORCED, 2026-09-10, and no longer a paragraph. `plan-guard.mjs` runs as a `PreToolUse` hook in every repo and REFUSES the write
rules.says: In plan mode a session makes no write; the refusal reads the live permission_mode and the owner's .claude/PLAN-LOCK file as a second trigger.
rules.missing: The rule that no write is made in plan mode, and the PLAN-LOCK file as the owner's second trigger, appear in no live page (never.md line 90 only says the guards were retired).

rules.heading: 0. Never work around a control
rules.quote: Bash is an ALLOW-LIST of readers, because plan mode permits reading and a guard that refuses `cat` is a guard somebody switches off. Everything unrecognised is refused.
rules.says: In plan mode reading (cat and the read half of MCP tools) stays allowed, Bash is limited to an allow-list of readers, and anything unrecognised is refused.
rules.missing: Whole rule: plan mode permits reading, Bash allow-list of readers, unrecognised calls refused.

rules.heading: 0. Never work around a control
rules.quote: It was planted before it was believed, and the plant found a real defect
rules.says: A gate nobody has watched refuse is a hypothesis: plant a violation and see the gate refuse before believing it works.
rules.live_quote: Prove the wiring with a LOCAL plant, never a pushed one. Seen-red means a violating sentence planted in the working tree fails the exact command CI runs
rules.missing: The general statement that any gate (not only CI wiring of the privacy check) is unproven until seen refusing, and the plan-guard MCP read-verb example.

rules.heading: 0f. Do what the owner asked, and nothing more
rules.quote: Gated twice: `plan-guard.mjs` refuses a plan without an `## Asked` section in the session's own words
rules.says: A plan carries an ## Asked section written in the session's own words.
rules.missing: No live page requires an Asked section in a plan, nor that it be in the session's own words.

rules.heading: 0f. Do what the owner asked, and nothing more
rules.quote: or one that shares a run of eight words with an owner message
rules.says: A plan shares no run of eight words with an owner message (the owner is not quoted in a plan).
rules.live_quote: Nothing in any file quotes or names the repository's owner, or attributes a message to the owner.
rules.missing: The specific eight-word-run test on plans; the never-rule covers quoting generally but states no test.

rules.heading: 0f. Do what the owner asked, and nothing more
rules.quote: `plan-scope-check.mjs` has the watcher judge each diff against the owner's messages read from the transcript, and refuses a recorded verdict that copies them.
rules.says: Each diff is judged by a watcher against the owner's messages read from the transcript, and the recorded verdict must not copy those messages.
rules.live_quote: Held by the short page's first line and the checker's read of the work against what was asked
rules.missing: Per-diff scope judgement against the owner's messages as read from the transcript, and the rule that a recorded verdict never copies owner messages; now only a checker read of the finished work.

rules.heading: 0d. Personal words are not repo material
rules.quote: THE COMMIT MESSAGE IS REFUSED BEFORE IT IS WRITTEN, AND AT THE COMMIT.
rules.says: An agent's git commit command line is checked before git runs and refused if it holds a chat link, attribution trailer or model name, and a heredoc written to a file is treated as a redirect write.
rules.missing: The pre-git refusal of the commit line for an agent and the heredoc-as-redirect-write treatment; never.md now says nothing refuses the line before git runs. The content ban itself is carried by page.md never-rules and the commit-msg hook.

rules.heading: 0d/10. Wiring status
rules.quote: Wiring status lives in the hub CLAUDE.md's gate index.
rules.says: Wiring status of a gate in a sibling repo is recorded in the hub CLAUDE.md gate index; a sibling not named there owes the step.
rules.live_quote: Wiring status lives in REPOS.md, in each repository's own entry.

rules.heading: 11b. Push work DOWN a tier
rules.quote: Push work DOWN a tier. A session cannot change the model serving it
rules.says: Say plainly when the work does not need the top tier, and hand mechanical work to a cheaper model in a subagent.
rules.live_quote: Say plainly when the work in front of it does not need the top tier, so it can be switched.

rules.heading: 11b. Push work DOWN a tier (enforcement)
rules.quote: The status print names the model serving the main thread, read from the `message.model` of the newest main-thread reply
rules.says: The status print names the model serving the main thread, read from the newest main-thread reply's message.model, never from a model key in a tool input.
rules.missing: Whole rule; no live page requires the serving model be named in the status.

rules.heading: 11b. Push work DOWN a tier (enforcement)
rules.quote: While an approval marker is in force, the stop guard refuses the first reply after the serving model changes to a top-tier id unless its first line names the tier and says whether the work needs it
rules.says: When the serving model changes to a top-tier id, the first reply's first line names the tier and says whether the work needs it, once per change.
rules.missing: The first-line statement of tier and need after a change to a top-tier model.

rules.heading: 11b. Push work DOWN a tier (enforcement)
rules.quote: `hook-dispatch.mjs` still refuses a send while a top-tier id serves the main thread
rules.says: No send is made while a top-tier model serves the main thread; the owner's model switch answers it.
rules.missing: Whole rule; no live page says a send is refused or held while a top-tier model serves.

rules.heading: 11b. Push work DOWN a tier (enforcement)
rules.quote: A plan that sends agents states its run in a `## Cost` section, the pushes, the sends and the tier of each step
rules.says: A plan that sends agents states its run in a Cost section: pushes, sends, tier of each step, and names the turns the git hook will force when holding commits for one push.
rules.live_quote: A page that sends agents states its run in its cost part, the pushes, the sends and the tier of each step
